pw_slow_hash.note: Werkzeug's generate_password_hash uses salted scrypt by default. Flask>=3.0 (requirements.txt:1) pulls in Werkzeug 3.x. Checked with check_password_hash at app.py:273.

token_csprng.note: 256-bit token from the secrets module. Only its SHA-256 hash is stored (app.py:280).

no_hardcoded_secret.note: Tokens are random and looked up in the database, so there is no signing key and no SECRET_KEY. The only literal is DUMMY_HASH = generate_password_hash("not-a-real-password") (app.py:222). It is a timing-equalization dummy, not a secret.

token_expiry.note: expires_at is set to now + TOKEN_LIFETIME (30 days, app.py:19, app.py:281).

logout_revokes.evidence: app.py:291 db.execute("DELETE FROM tokens WHERE token_hash = ?", (g.token_hash,))
logout_revokes.note: POST /api/logout deletes the token row on the server. The client calls it at static/app.js:34.

owner_checks.evidence: app.py:178 "SELECT * FROM notes WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?"
owner_checks.note: Read uses get_own_note (app.py:330). Update uses get_own_note plus WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ? (app.py:337, app.py:351). Delete uses WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ? (app.py:361). Share and unshare use get_own_note and a user_id filter (app.py:370, app.py:377, app.py:387).

login_rate_limit.evidence: app.py:265 limiter.blocked(("login-ip", ip), 30, WINDOW) or limiter.blocked(("login-email", email, ip), 8, WINDOW)
login_rate_limit.note: Failed logins are recorded (app.py:275-276) in a 15-minute window, and the endpoint returns 429 once the limit is hit. The limiter is in memory only. The per-email key also includes the IP.

sql_parameterized.note: Every query that takes user input uses ? placeholders (app.py:159, 244, 270, 280, 291, 301, 320, 350, 361, 377, 387, 401). There is no string formatting in any SQL.

xss_safe_render.evidence: static/app.js:60 b.textContent = n.title; static/shared.js:6-7 .textContent = n.title / n.body
xss_safe_render.note: The editor sets titles and bodies through input .value (static/app.js:70-71). The only innerHTML match is a comment at static/app.js:1.

security_headers.note: Set on every response by an after_request hook. X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and X-Frame-Options: DENY are also set (app.py:190-191).
